raw_record.question_text:
The following figure is a contour map of a certain place. Read the figure and answer:

<image1>

Among the four slope lines 1, 2, 3, and 4 in the figure, which one has the greatest average slope?

method.method_draft: 先描述图中四条坡面线的位置，再比较1、2、3、4沿线附近等高线的疏密。由于同一幅等高线图等高距一致，不必精确计算高差，只需找哪条线在相近高差内水平距离最短。读图发现2号坡面线穿过的等高线最密集，说明平均坡度最大，因此答案为2。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：这是一幅等高线地形图，左侧山地附近标出了1、2、3、4四条坡面线。1号线位于左侧山体中部偏右，2号线位于左侧山体向左下方延伸的坡面上，3号线位于左侧山体向左侧延伸的坡面上，4号线位于左侧山体上部偏北的位置。图中等高线在2号线附近排列最为密集，1、3、4号线附近等高线相对较疏。
推理：同一幅等高线图的等高距一致，坡度大小主要看相同高差内的水平距离，等高线越密集，水平距离越短，坡度越大。比较1、2、3、4四条坡面线沿线附近的等高线疏密，2号坡面线穿过的等高线最密集，因此平均坡度最大的是2号线。

raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: This is a contour topographic map. Near the mountainous area on the left, four slope lines, 1, 2, 3, and 4, are marked. Line 1 is located slightly to the right of the middle of the left-side mountain body, line 2 is located on the slope extending toward the lower left from the left-side mountain body, line 3 is located on the slope extending toward the left from the left-side mountain body, and line 4 is located in the upper, slightly northern part of the left-side mountain body. In the figure, the contours near line 2 are arranged most densely, while the contours near lines 1, 3, and 4 are relatively sparse.
Reasoning: On the same contour map, the contour interval is consistent. The size of the slope mainly depends on the horizontal distance within the same height difference; the denser the contours, the shorter the horizontal distance, and the greater the slope. Comparing the density of contours near the routes of the four slope lines 1, 2, 3, and 4, the contours crossed by slope line 2 are the densest, so the one with the greatest average slope is line 2.
